entries.zh: 强辩；执意争辩以压倒对方
entries.en: to argue stubbornly, contending obstinately until one prevails over others (porfiar vencándolos)

entries.zh: 争官位；争夺官职空缺（缺位）
entries.en: to contend over rank and office, striving for a vacant post (porfiar sobre la dignidad)
entries.notes: 缺位作官职空缺解，与 porfiar sobre la dignidad（争尊位）的对应依赖明清官缺用语推断

entries.zh: 争而不出声；暗自争执〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: to quarrel noiselessly, dispute without clamor 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕 (Spanish column partly damaged)
entries.notes: 西栏 porfiar mas no [残] veclar 残缺；依汉字諍無聲与音写 chie bo sia 定为无声争执

entries.zh: 争抢夺取；争斗中拏夺其物（拏梶）〔西栏疑字难辨，释义存疑〕
entries.en: to insist on snatching something away in a fight (Sp. partly illegible: porfiar sobre arrancar el … de pelear)
entries.notes: 西栏 [疑:pan/pabit] 与汉字梶均难确解，据拏（抓夺）与 arrancar（抢夺）取大意

entries.zh: 混占；混赖强占（争执归属不清而侵占）
entries.en: to seize and occupy disputed property, usurpingly (cf. porfiar cuyo es la era, contending whose it is)
entries.notes: 西栏 cuio Lera~ 疑为 cuyo es la era（争说田地归属）之略写，据汉字混占取义

entries.zh: 自以为大；争认孰优孰大（拏做大）
entries.en: to insist on which is better, claiming to be the greater (take oneself to be the senior)
to urge and entreat repeatedly; to appeal (porfiar)
entries.notes: L 栏 Porfiar 简式对应吁[疑:吁/呼]，依音写 chien 取吁

entries.zh: 固执的；死不认输的〔汉字与音写两栏难合，释义存疑〕
entries.en: obstinate, stubborn (porfiado; Chinese columns uncorroborated) 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: 汉字'推'与 porfiado（固执）义不合，音写 de esmusasi 无法解读，暂依西语词头取固执

entries.zh: 强——强求硬要；执意大声争执讲价
entries.en: obstinately; to insist forcefully, haggling or negotiating aloud (porfiado, a voces negociar)

entries.zh: 瑚石——一种坚致的美石（Porfigo 当为 Porfido，斑岩类坚石）
entries.en: porphyry (Porfido/Porfigo), a hard ornamental stone; Chinese 瑚石, 'coral-like stone'
entries.notes: 西栏 Porfigo 拼写疑为 Porfido（斑岩），汉字瑚石罕见，两栏对应存推断

entries.en: for the pores to open (abrirse los poros)

entries.zh: 瓷器〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: porcelain, china ware (porcelana; Chinese columns partly damaged) 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: 汉字栏仅存砵字、音写 vo 难证，依西语 porcelana 定为瓷器
L 栏两读 [疑:campanilla/porcelanilla]，汉字鐘仔与音写 cheng nia 证为 campanilla

entries.en: a small piece of porcelain, little china vessel (porcelanilla pequeña; cf. curculilla, a tiny cup)
entries.notes: 汉字 [疑:甎/碗] 两读，R 栏 g urculilla 仅残存，据西语 porcelanilla 取义

entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕 entry damaged: only abbreviated Spanish P. Escadilla~ remains (perhaps escadilla 'small ladder' or escudilla 'small bowl'); gloss withheld
entries.notes: 汉字、音写与官话栏全空，仅西栏缩写 P. Escadilla~ 可见
